title: Members of the Supreme Band
summary: Labat names the seven-piece Supreme Band lineup with Paul Maurice on clarinet and himself leading on violin.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Sure. The Supreme Band that was here? Yeah. That's right. Who was the members of it? Do you remember? Yes.

Every one of them did except me. Really? We had about seven of us. Who was the members of it? There was Armand Tweedo. What did he play? He played trombone. There was Babe Bennett. He played cornet. Paul Maurice played clarinet. I played the violin at that time. I was leading the orchestra, you see. And they had Manuel Alexander, he was the drummer. That's it? And Dota frozen boy, he played guitar. And Edward Anderson, he played the bass violin. That was the lineup we had. Yeah. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. He played the bass violin, that was the lineup we had.
Did Paul Maurice play any other instruments?

Well who was the drummer named Maurice? Manuel Alexander, I mentioned his name. No, but there's a drummer named Maurice. From here. From here, huh? What? I'm not confused. I must be confused. You're confused. Yeah, I'm thinking he's a saxophone player or something. There's seven pieces we had. Oh yeah. Something, I must have them all mixed up, you know. I hear so many names in a day it's hard to keep them all straight. Yes sir.

Well there's a drummer in the island by the name of Norbert Maurice. This fellow, Paul Maurice, would play clarinet with our orchestra. He's his boy, Norman's uncle, you see. He used to play drum, he too, but he lives in the islands now.
What about the Supreme Band? When was it going?
